  \caption{Experiment 1: the explained network of each dataset, with the columns of the Experiment 2 run tables. Selection: the paper genomes are the AAAI paper's; WHAS500 is the lowest validation Cox loss of five seeds; Connect-4 and the synthetic sets are the largest training AUC of their runs (seed in brackets). AUCs and intervals are recomputed from each genome on its study's split (10{,}000 bootstrap resamples of the test rows) and equal the study's run record. $^\ast$WHAS500 is a Cox model: its train and test columns are Harrell's $C$. \emph{Inputs used}, \emph{hidden nodes}, \emph{enabled connections}, \emph{depth} and \emph{skip connections} are of the phenotype; \emph{skippiness} and \emph{density} are the library's \texttt{ExplaNEAT} measures on the genome, as in Experiment 2. Explanation columns are of the stored explanation: leaf $+$ composition annotations, node splits, identity nodes, structural / compositional coverage and the function-preservation error (largest absolute difference between the explained model and the network on the training rows).
